arguments:
set -euo pipefail
printf 'REA_ISOLATION_AUDIT=2026-11-04\n'
for p in /home/ubuntu/rea-original-upstream-680 /home/ubuntu/rea-final-runtime /home/ubuntu/rea-final-runtime/bin/rea-mcp /opt/rea-reversa /srv/projects/rea-final /srv/projects/engenharia-reversa-final /srv/projects/skill-universal /home/ubuntu/.local/share/motor-ferrari /home/ubuntu/.local/share/motor-ferrari/.runtime/npm/rea /home/ubuntu/.local/share/motor-ferrari/.runtime/npm/rea/node_modules/.bin/rea; do
  if [ -e "$p" ] || [ -L "$p" ]; then
    printf 'PATH_PRESENT=%s\n' "$p"
    stat -c 'PATH_META=%F|%U|%G|%n' "$p"
    readlink -f "$p" | sed 's/^/PATH_REAL=/'
  else printf 'PATH_ABSENT=%s\n' "$p"; fi
done
for p in /srv/projects /home/ubuntu; do
  if [ -d "$p" ]; then find "$p" -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 2 \( -iname '*rea*' -o -iname '*revers*' \) -print | head -40 | sed 's/^/CANDIDATE=/' ; fi
done
for p in /etc/systemd/system /home/ubuntu/.config/systemd/user; do
  if [ -d "$p" ]; then find "$p" -maxdepth 2 -type f \( -name '*.service' -o -name '*.timer' \) -print0 | xargs -0 -r grep -IlE '(/opt/rea-reversa|rea-original-upstream-680|rea-final-runtime|motor-ferrari)' | head -35 | sed 's/^/SYSTEMD_REFERENCER=/' ; fi
done
ps -eo comm= | grep -Ei '(rea|ferrari)' | sort -u | sed 's/^/ACTIVE_PROCESS_NAME=/' || :
printf 'REA_AUDIT_FINISHED=PASS\n'
